integrity: Proof and exact rational diagnostic program are embedded; finite tests corroborate but do not establish the general theorem. The review below is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Real-valued periodic sequences; exact sharpness proved for n >= 8r; the upper inequality holds for n >= 2r+1. Does not cover padded boundaries, multivariate spatial medians or iteration. An unindexed historical two-input BV estimate is a possible priority risk.
title: Sharp total-variation perturbation constant for sliding median filters
